import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[] kn = new int[n + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            kn[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            int key = kn[i];
            int j = i - 1;
            while (j >= 1 && kn[j] > key) {
                kn[j + 1] = kn[j];
                j--;
            }
            kn[j + 1] = key;
        }
        System.out.println(kn[(1 + n) / 2]);
    }
}
